lemma_quote: Καὶ ἐλθὼν κατῴκησεν εἰς πόλιν λεγομένην Ναζαρέτ.

cross_references.note: harmonization: Luke's presentation and return to Nazareth (Luke 2:22-39)

notes: First half of Matt. 2:23. Theophylact harmonizes with Luke's infancy narrative (a genuine cross-reference).
lemma_quote_en: And having come, he dwelt in a city called Nazareth
